verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a REST API (OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at /rest/v0) and a separate sandbox server, so its ledger can be driven programmatically without the UI. However, API access is gated by request, sandbox credentials are issued manually, the API was built for platform-to-platform integrations, and nothing addresses CI pipelines. Missing for 10: a CLI or documented headless/CI workflow, self-serve credentials suitable for automation, CI-oriented docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
